data.summary: The recognizable paper woman opens a distinct teal umbrella and folded drops bounce off it. The canopy stays above her instead of sheltering the cream flower, which continues to receive drops. The push-in crops the canopy on the left.

observations.text: The braided paper woman raises the closed umbrella with both hands and opens it above her head. Her layered clothing, separate leaf cape and paper construction remain recognizable.

Blue and turquoise folded drops bounce and tumble off the open canopy. Its left edge moves outside the frame. The right-side cream flower stays beyond the umbrella coverage and receives falling drops.

She glances toward the flower and then back toward camera while holding the upright umbrella. No sheltering tilt occurs. The complete canopy and final shared shelter are absent; drops still fall onto the exposed flowers.
